reviews.title: App Update Failed
reviews.text: The app forced an update.  Introduced an SMS text at login to verify identity.  It doesn’t work!  The code fails every time.  App them appears to show me logged in but logs me right back out when I try to make a reservation and the failed code process starts all over again.  Customer service doesn’t answer the phone.  You’d think an app update would be tested before releasing it.  It’s been two days and still broken!

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: While it does not warn you during set up, you must use your full legal name when signing up for rewards or nothing will work as expected. (I use my middle name for everything include all other rewards accounts with no issue) Once the account is created you can only make updates in person at a rewards desk so I can’t use any of the features I signed up to get in the first place. Unnecessary headache with an easy fix. Hope they update the system.

reviews.title: Horrible check in at Mandalay Bay
reviews.text: Booked a weekend room for wife and I.  We arrive after a 6hr flight + 3hr delay only to be welcome by a 1hr wait in their lobby check in. Was hoping to use this app but it is unable to find my reservation. Tried searching for it by our check in/out dates as well as confirmation number. Keep getting the same error message “reservation not found”. Be ready to be truly welcome by MGM resorts’ hospitality.

reviews.title: Too difficult!
reviews.text: Trying to find answers about Freeplay is next to impossible with one person spinning you to the next person. I have Freeplay that appears and disappears on the same week, sometimes the same day! I really like MGM properties and go out of my way to give them my business. But the Rewards system is terrible to use! In person, a Rewards Desk will also do the same spin.

reviews.title: Arrival/Check in sucks
reviews.text: No carts to carry stuff anywhere near ride share. Had to leave all my stuff by the curb while I go to get a cart. Then can’t check in on the kiosks since my roommate already did but a person can check me in. Make it make sense? Why?? Both our names are on the reservation why can’t I just get a key and go in? How much money do ya’ll have and you can’t even do these easy things?

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: MGM pearl member and mgm credit card holder and I’ve never received a free bet or room! They don’t value loyal customers they told me if I was a new customer I would receive better offers. Worst casino in Ohio and lower end casinos and hotels in Vegas. Choose ceasers every time if you’re smart! Update mgm won’t allow me to use that app at all anymore.
